Chaitanya starts from Point Y and drives 15 km towards the South. He then takes a left turn, drives 16 km, turns right and drives 56 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 35 km. He takes a left turn, drives 29 km. He then turns right, drives 27 km, turns left and drives 42 km to stop at Point Z. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point Y again? (All turns are 90-degree turns only unless specified.)
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (78 km towards the west) है।

questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (66 km towards the south) है।

Each of L, M, N, O, P, Q and R has an exam on a different day of a week starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week. O answers an exam on Tuesday. Only three people answer an exam between O and P. N is the last person to answer an exam. M answers an exam immediately before O. R answers an exam on one of the days before P but immediately after L. L answers an exam immediately after O. On which day does Q answer an exam?
878

Given below is a statement (Cause) followed by possible effects numbered I, II and III. Read the cause carefully and decide which of the three can be the possible effect(s).Cause: Internationally acclaimed Author P released his highly anticipated Book Y based on the non-fiction genre last week.Effects: I. Bookstores in major cities have reported record sales.II. Author P has stated that he will be writing a sequel to Book Y.III. Numerous scholars of literature have called for a reassessment of classical literary works.
options: Only I and III are possible effects.
Only II and III are possible effects.
All I, II, and III are possible effects.
Only I and II are possible effects.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Only I and II are possible effects.) है।

K sits second to the left of H and faces V. X sits second to the right of T. P sits on one of the ends and faces H. J does not sit to the immediate next of H. Who among the following faces T? 631

questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (B @ D + K ! O = Z) है।
